# Fade Factory ATL

Fade Factory ATL is a barbershop at 1000 Northside Dr NW #206, Atlanta, GA 30318 (West Midtown, inside My Salon Suites).

## Services
- Male Haircut (40 min)
- Line Up (30 min)
- Beard Shaping (30 min)
- Dreadlock Line Up & Taper (30 min)
- Head Shave & Beard Groom (30 min)
- Head Shave (30 min)

## Hours
Monday–Tuesday: By Appointment Only | Wednesday–Sunday: 9 AM – 7 PM

## Contact
Phone: (470) 813-3745 | Instagram: @fadefactory_atl

## Booking
Walk-ins welcome Wed–Sun. Monday and Tuesday by appointment only. Online booking via Booksy.
